traits.name: Aura of Fear
traits.text: Enemies that move adjacent must Save or lose the rest of their turn.

traits.name: Sense Fear
traits.text: Advantage to attack Distracted or Harried enemies, or those who Panicked last turn.

miss_trigger.text: Enemy must Save before it can attack you again. Lasts until the Save is made.

traits.name: Stable Footing
traits.text: Save to ignore being knocked Prone. Reduce Forced Move by 1.

traits.name: Tentacles
traits.text: You may move normally while Grabbing enemies, dragging them.

traits.name: Oily Carapace
traits.text: Advantage on Escape rolls. Disadvantage to enemy Escape rolls.

miss_trigger.text: Grab an adjacent enemy or move your Speed towards a ranged enemy.
